card.line: Seir is a mountain region southeast of the Dead Sea, the land of Esau and the Edomites, which God gave to Esau as his own possession.

moments.title: Jacob sends word to Esau
moments.text: Jacob sent messengers ahead to his brother Esau in the land of Seir. They came back with news that Esau was coming to meet him with four hundred men, and Jacob was afraid.

moments.title: Esau settles in Seir
moments.text: Esau and his family had so many possessions that they could not live near Jacob. So Esau moved away and settled in the area of Mount Seir.

moments.title: Israel passes by Seir
moments.text: God told Israel not to provoke the descendants of Esau in Seir, because He had given Mount Seir to Esau. Israel paid for their food and water and passed by.

moments.title: God defeats the armies
moments.text: As Judah's singers praised the LORD, enemy armies were defeated. The Ammonites and Moabites destroyed the people of Mount Seir, and then they helped destroy one another.
